subject: ddl: enlarge general ddl worker pool (#54041)
summary: Diff increases `generalWorkerCnt` from 1->10 and tightens DDL concurrency gating by (1) filling `Job.InvolvingSchemaInfo` for `DROP SCHEMA` (db.*) and `CREATE TABLE` jobs that contain foreign keys (include referenced tables), and (2) fixing `runningJobs.checkRunnable` so jobs involving `db.*` correctly conflict with any in-flight job in that database. No Blocker/High correctness, consistency, compatibility, or metadata/state-machine issues found in the touched DDL/add-index scheduling/metadata behavior.
